calls.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original full-body RPG character identity portrait on genuinely transparent alpha background. Create Hải (aw2-hai), an original adult male guardian for Vietnamese food-memory fantasy Adventure World 2; Canh chua-inspired palette, no literal food mascot. Compact strong build, friendly alert mature face, short dark swept hair, practical teal/sea-green layered tunic with a few pale water-colored fabric accents, dark trousers and sturdy boots. He carries one original curved shield suggesting a calm water surface in his left arm; free right arm open to guide companions home. Entire body, both boots, shield and fingertips visible with generous empty margins. Polished clean HD anime game illustration, warm readable face, precise anatomy, restrained painterly shading, three-quarter view facing viewer-right. Neutral balanced ready stance; no FX obscuring identity. Outfit simple enough to reproduce in small sprite cels. This is his own new design, no borrowed named characters, logos, religious or historical insignia. No scene, floor, drop shadow, text, watermark, border, UI or extra characters. All space outside the subject genuinely transparent. One character only.

Use case: identity-preserve. Transform the supplied original Hải identity portrait into a production sprite sheet for Adventure World 2. Preserve the exact friendly adult male face, short dark swept hair, teal/sea-green clothing, dark boots and single curved water-inspired shield. Original project character, no borrowed IP. Exactly FOUR columns and FOUR rows (16 cels), square canvas. Each cel independently centered in its quarter, entirely contained; generous fully transparent gutters at every quarter-grid boundary and all outer edges. Each figure at most 65% of its cell width and 72% cell height; all shield, hair, hands, cloth and boots fit well inside. Never cross cells, never crop or cut off feet/shield. NO TEXT, labels, grid lines, background, floor, shadows or watermark. Background alpha genuinely transparent. Equal logical character proportions through cels; no extra shields or limbs.  Pixel/chibi exploration sprite art with visible crisp pixel steps, small three-head-tall body, no HD painted edges. Every row is ONE separately authored facing direction: row1 down/front, row2 left, row3 right, row4 up/back. Four columns per row: idle with both feet planted; left foot forward; passing stance; right foot forward. Consistent shield ownership and readable dark teal silhouette in all four directions, real back view in last row. No effects.
